summary: User transferred USDT between two centralized exchanges. After the receiving exchange rejected the deposit and returned the funds, the refund was sent to a generic BingX wallet address, requiring manual recovery by the exchange. The funds were not automatically credited to the user's account.
user_mistake: Transferred funds directly between custodial exchanges without considering refund handling procedures
prevention: Use a self-custody wallet as an intermediary when transferring assets between exchanges / Confirm deposit and refund policies before initiating transfers
